purpose: Full admitted source-only vocabulary with fixed original native reference queries; distinct from secondary outer-fold validation
panel: Require actual completed frozen_secondary_reference_panel plus externally supplied SHA, exact source genotype/annotation mappings and valid recorded partitions; no synthetic or substituted panel
source_training: All and only admitted observed source genomes from Sample rows. No source CV performance input or native outcome input. Preserve full final-source training independently of negative source CV results.

native_queries.source: Exact 5 native_query_proteomes in hash-bound native design, original called DNA/FAA/GFF bytes; query_only:true; no caller rerun or annotation filling

outcome_asset_boundary: Do not open native-design bound cases.csv, WIsH scores, target labels or interpretation assets. Only the native design JSON and its explicit query DNA/FAA/GFF bindings are inputs to this component. Panel labels are not consumed for vocabulary construction.
normalization: Reuse frozen secondary helper pure source normalization with empty native-query stage and separately append actual native input proteomes; no fake outer-fold panel. Retain order/copies/X, remove one terminal stop, globally neutral distinct train/native/control IDs. No molecular sequence design.
software_deviation: MMseqs18-8cc5c rather than paper-listed15.6f452; effective defaults retained in logs; v2 SEARCH alignment-mode3, clustering unchanged; v3 adds ordinary external training projection and explicitly versions mapping-outcome controls.
timeout_rationale: Declared before secondary runs: complete reference annotation inventories contain 114719 host proteins, substantially larger than source phage pilots. Bounded 1800s per serial command; no retry or parameter change on timeout.
vocabulary: Fit from ordinary external training projections, including explicit missing-hit diagnostics; occurrence>1 training genome and occurrence-vector consolidation unchanged. Freeze after command6 before external query createdb command7.
projection: Ordinary query_db against the same frozen train_db with identical SEARCH option vectors. Native query rosters and labels boundary unchanged.
mapping_control: Compare every copied protein under ordinary external training/query projection: count same assigned family, both unassigned and assignment discrepancies separately. Require zero assignment discrepancies, complete unique comparison coverage and exact feature-vector equality. Matched absence is not successful family identification. Report nonzero status separately; empty vocabulary is ready_for_fitting=false. This new v3 contract never relabels a v1/v2 failure.
report: Complete status requires all nine declared commands with observed zero exits and the v3 mapping-outcome/vector control. Preserve exact inventories, missing-hit diagnostics, zero vectors, command logs and all artifact hashes.
plan_only: No external tools and no raw/output writes; missing actual frozen panel returns HOLD without execution.
failure: Keep completed outputs, raw logs and explicit failure. No auto rerun, substitute sequence, candidate change, feature threshold adjustment or source performance conditioning.
revision_reason: Before any biological model fit: replace privileged training-self projection with ordinary external-query projection after the preserved v2 candidate-control failure and prospectively fixed focal/complete-copy diagnostics. Version the missing-assignment control contract explicitly. No phenotype-dependent selection or threshold adjustment.
identity_semantics: Only the two SEARCH commands request --alignment-mode 3: aligned-residue sequence identity is computed for their --min-seq-id 0.4 criterion and downstream hit ranking, under unchanged seq-id/coverage defaults. Clustering retains its original --min-seq-id 0.4 score-based estimated-similarity parameter/default behavior; this is not an assertion of exact-identity clustering or exhaustive homology detection.

projection_symmetry.training_projection: Create an independent train_projection_db from the same normalized training.faa, then search it against train_db. No same-prefix training-self projection. Clustering still uses train_db only.
projection_symmetry.query_projection: Ordinary query_db against the same frozen train_db with identical SEARCH option vectors.

projection_symmetry.control: Compare every copied protein under ordinary external training/query projection: count same assigned family, both unassigned and assignment discrepancies separately. Require zero assignment discrepancies, complete unique comparison coverage and exact feature-vector equality. Matched absence is not successful family identification. Report nonzero status separately; empty vocabulary is ready_for_fitting=false. This new v3 contract never relabels a v1/v2 failure.

projection_symmetry.unchanged: Source/target rosters, group splits, masks, labels, model settings, RFE rules, baselines, endpoints, decision thresholds and study interpretation.
